routeDecision.boundary: #188 proves the canonical ledger receiver, immutable source/output bindings, deterministic postings, official mappings, golden journals, and fail-closed behavior. #199 proves actual source-owner production and executable agreement with every canonical downstream calculator after #195.

criteria.requirement: The canonical ledger contract reconstructs any January 1-to-as-of fact set and deterministically rejects incomplete source coverage or coded gaps before posting/close; live source-owner production is accepted only by #199.
criteria.expectedResult: For any as-of date, the ledger accepts only the exact January 1-through-as-of source topology and economic fact set, binds it immutably, and blocks missing coverage, declared gaps, stale evidence, replay mismatch, or an unsupported case before posting or close. Actual source-owner production remains a mandatory #199 proof.

criteria.requirement: Balanced immutable postings, reversals/corrections, locks, documents, actors, correlation, and idempotency are deterministic.
criteria.expectedResult: Every accepted command produces one balanced immutable result with deterministic correction, lock, document, actor, correlation and replay behavior; invalid or duplicate input creates no partial state.

criteria.requirement: All #172 accepted ledger patterns have pinned official-source mappings, versioned golden inputs/journals, and typed downstream projection contracts.

sources.version: owner-approved split: real calculator agreement deferred to #199

criteria.expectedResult: Every supported #172 ledger pattern has a versioned official-source citation, deterministic golden input and balanced canonical journal, declared typed downstream consumers, and coded fail-closed cases. No fixture declaration is represented as proof that a future calculator already agrees.

criteria.requirement: Unsupported operating/foreign/complex/judgment cases fail closed before posting.
criteria.expectedResult: Every blocked #172 pattern returns its coded risk response before any ledger/source/document mutation.

criteria.requirement: Reconstruction and close bind immutable stable-ID/revision/hash source attestations and downstream output declarations to the exact economic-fact digest; historical, unbound, stale, or mismatched evidence cannot be current. #199 proves actual source-owned derivation and cross-output agreement.
criteria.expectedResult: The ledger independently binds all 13 typed source attestations and all seven close-output declarations to the current economic-fact digest, rejects partial or mismatched pairs, and refuses to treat historical unbound evidence as current. The contract states—and tests preserve—that these declarations are not themselves proof of source-owned derivation; #199 must supply that proof.

criteria.requirement: No TypeScript/SQL duplicate rules or new compatibility records.
criteria.expectedResult: Architecture analysis finds one Python ledger implementation, no added facade/scope and no duplicate TypeScript or SQL accounting policy.
